podcasts.title: 384 - Behind The Sound, Music & Editing That Bring Stories To Life
podcasts.transcript: This episode was recorded live in Toronto during TIFF, as part of Behind The Camera House. The idea was to get composers, picture editors & supervising sound editors all together to discuss how they can work together more efficiently and understand the challenges they are each facing.
